GOOD QUESTIONS. CLEAR ANSWERS.

A little clarity.
A lot less back-and-forth.

Answers about Cowlendar setup, pricing, calendars, group bookings, deposits and support for your Shopify service business.

What is Cowlendar?

Cowlendar is a Shopify booking app for appointments, group sessions, events and multi-day rentals. It connects bookable services to your Shopify storefront.

Can I try Cowlendar for free?

Yes. Cowlendar has a free plan with all features. Paid plans use booking-revenue tiers. See the pricing page and Shopify listing for usage allowances and optional charges.

Do I need to code?

The app provides a booking widget and configuration tools. Setup depends on your theme and service rules; support can help confirm the right installation approach.

Can I take group or multi-day bookings?

Cowlendar lists both. Configure the actual participant capacity, resource availability and date boundaries, then test them with your service.

Which calendars and meeting tools can I use?

Cowlendar lists Google Calendar, Outlook, Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams. Apple Calendar support is also part of our integration information; confirm the connection and synchronization behavior for your setup.

Can customers cancel or reschedule?

Cowlendar provides cancellation and rescheduling workflows. Configure your policy and verify booking changes and payment refunds separately.

Can I collect a deposit?

Booking deposits and prepayment are supported features. Confirm the remaining-balance workflow and payment-provider behavior. A booking advance is different from a rental damage bond.

Will it work for my business?

Start with your most important availability rule: staff, rooms, equipment, seats or a date range. Test a real booking and a conflict before launching. Our guides cover several industries.

Where can I get help?

Use the in-app support chat or the Cowlendar help center. Include the service, relevant date and a clear description of the issue so the team can investigate.

How do I compare Cowlendar with another app?

Use our comparison directory for sourced plan and feature tables. We explain which businesses may prefer each product, including alternatives to Cowlendar.
